findings.evidence: First project run found 40 leads but all six selected documents were inaccessible or not found. New cases prioritize project routes and open bidding, retain coherent deliverable phrases, and change queries after two consecutive inaccessible reads while existing search/document limits remain enforced.

Intermediate service run classified two complete freelance buyer briefs as jobs/contracts, excluding them from service matching. Complete parser-confirmed buyer provenance now survives review mapping and normalizes positive demand to client_request; negative verdicts and incomplete captures remain excluded.

Intermediate project decisions described generic React.js and Enterprise links as if they were the parent buyer brief. Hints no longer transfer individual posting text or demand onto unread child pages; collection context remains available.

Final project flow assessed two buyer requests; one generic JavaScript role was excluded and a flexible-stack remote screenwriting SPA request was recommended. Intermediate Australia-only project was excluded for the US test profile. Final service flow withheld a completed historical project and recommended two current redesign requests.

runs.limitations: AI estimates exclude unpriced/failed attempts, infrastructure and billing adjustments. Search reservations are configured upper allowances, not invoices. Source labels and dashboard acceptance are not independent usefulness judgments. Distinct URLs may still describe the same opportunity; repeatedDestinations detects only observed redirect identity. Initial reports recorded a dashboard sample, not every source review.
